A '''command gauntlet''' was a specialized [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] worn by select members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] command staff on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Echo Base Rebels wearing the command gauntlet included [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] and [[Pharl McQuarrie/Legends|Pharl McQuarrie]]. The gauntlet differed from the [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|Alliance Cold Weather Gloves]], worn by Echo Base Rebels of lesser import.
